how_to_apply: IOL Apply Online is not applicable for this recruitment - applications must be submitted offline, by Post/Speed Post only, in the prescribed format.
Download the application format given at Annexure-A to the advertisement from the IOL website (https://indiaoptel.in), under the 'Career' section.
Fill the application form in BLOCK LETTERS only, entering all required details including qualification, experience, and category.
Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents (age proof, qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, caste/category certificate, etc., as applicable to the post).
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph on the application form.
Superscribe the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ___ ON FIXED TERM CONTRACT BASIS", naming the specific post applied for.
Send the completed application by Speed Post only to: The Chairman & Managing Director, India Optel Limited, OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun (Uttarakhand) – 248008.
Ensure the application reaches IOL HQ on or before the closing date (03-10-2026). IOL is not responsible for postal delay or loss in transit.
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
important_instructions: Engagement is purely on a Fixed Term Contract basis and does not confer any claim to regular/permanent employment with IOL. Canvassing in any form, or use of outside influence to secure engagement, will lead to disqualification. Applications received after the closing date, or that are incomplete, illegible, not in the prescribed format, or without self-attested copies of required certificates, will be summarily rejected. IOL's decision on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and the selection process is final. Any legal dispute arising out of this recruitment is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts/tribunals at Dehradun (Uttarakhand). Candidates must keep their e-mail ID and mobile number active throughout the engagement process, as all official communication will be sent by e-mail. Candidates currently employed in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies are advised to obtain prior permission from their employer before applying. IOL reserves the right to raise or curtail the number of vacancies advertised or the eligibility criteria; any such change will be notified only on the official website.

content_sections.heading: India Optel Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Project Technician: Screening and shortlisting for a Trade Test (Practical) based on percentage of marks in the final NTC/NAC examination (candidates called at twice the number of positions); the Trade Test is qualifying in nature, and final merit is based solely on NTC/NAC marks. Welfare Officer: Screening of applications, shortlisting for interview (twice the number of positions) based on percentage of marks in the Bachelor's Degree, followed by a personal interview; final merit is based on interview performance. Junior Project Engineer: Screening, shortlisting for interview (twice the number of vacancies) based on percentage of marks in Diploma/B.Sc., followed by a personal interview; final merit is a weighted score of 75% Diploma/B.Sc. marks and 25% interview performance. Consultant (Coordination): Screening, shortlisting, and a personal interview; selection is based on interview performance and meeting the required eligibility criteria. Document verification from original certificates is carried out before the personal interview/Trade Test for all posts; discrepancies found during verification can lead to rejection of candidature. Ties in merit are resolved first by Ex-Trade Apprentice preference (Project Technician only), then by older age, then alphabetical order of names. No virtual/online interview is conducted for any post, and requests to change the interview/test date, venue, or time are not entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IOL Recruitment 2026 is a Fixed Term Contract engagement drive by India Optel Limited, a Ministry of Defence PSU, for Project Technician, Junior Project Engineer, Welfare Officer, and Consultant (Coordination) posts under Advertisement No. IOLHqrs/100(6)/2026-Rectt.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 160 vacancies in total across all post categories (this is a computed sum of the post-wise figures; the notification does not state one combined total).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date/closing date for receipt of applications at IOL HQ is the 21st day from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News. The exact calendar date is not specified in the notification provided.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: NTC/NAC trade certificate for Project Technician, Bachelor's + Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Social Work/HR/Labour Welfare for Welfare Officer, a relevant Diploma or B.Sc. Degree for Junior Project Engineer, and retired Army officer (Major/Lt. Colonel) status for Consultant (Coordination).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limit is 18–32 years for Project Technician, 27–45 years for Welfare Officer, 18–35 years for Junior Project Engineer, and a maximum of 62 years for Consultant (Coordination), as on the closing date of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is NIL for all post categories.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline only, in the prescribed Annexure-A format, sent by Speed Post to IOL HQ at Raipur, Dehradun. There is no online application mode for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves screening, shortlisting, and either a Trade Test (for Project Technician) or a personal interview (for Welfare Officer, Junior Project Engineer, and Consultant), followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for IOL Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from ₹20,000–₹65,000 (Project Technician), ₹30,000–₹1,20,000 (Junior Project Engineer), and ₹40,000–₹1,40,000 (Welfare Officer), plus allowances; Consultant (Coordination) draws a fixed monthly remuneration of ₹1,00,000 (Major) or ₹1,30,000 (Lt. Colonel).

faq.question: Q10. Where are the IOL Recruitment 2026 posts located?
faq.answer: Most posts are based at IOL's units in Dehradun (Uttarakhand); the Welfare Officer post also covers Chandigarh, and the Consultant (Coordination) post covers Agra, Delhi, Pune, Avadi, and Tiruchirappalli (indicative, subject to transfer).
